Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: If this is what you are thinking, I will not waste your time.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Let me explain, before you get l'impression that I was using you pour mon divertissement. I very much appreciate you visiting me and helping me feel less lonely.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: But I think that I must do the rest of my soul-searching on my own.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Indeed, this is goodbye. I will remember you for as long as I live.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: If I find good soil, that can be centuries. Long after you rejoin la terre, so I will not be doing any forgetting during your lifetime. Do not worry.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He's already set to travel, apparently, as he flashes you a small smile, and heads off to the lower levels. You don't see him bringing any particular gear with himself, so you wonder...

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Well, Kweebecs can probably feed themselves on soil -- which is virtually everywhere, unless you head into Howling Sands -- and drinking any random puddle of water is far less dangerous for them than for the animal species.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: But what about Trork lumberjacks? Or Outlanders? Or--

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: Nah, you'll stop overthinking this. Surely Canuck Kweebec knows what he's doing if he and his 'brother', or whoever that guy really was, came all the way over here in the first place.

Line.Text: You wonder if he would've invited you to come along if he liked you better. He doesn't seem to pay much attention to overt flirting, but perhaps showing kindness and playing along with his whims would've done the trick.

Actions.Title: Uh-oh
Actions.Message:
Huh. Looks like you failed to charm him. If this wasn't part of the plan, maybe you should play along with the more wholesome of his whims next time.

If you want to try again, first exit Kweebdrasil, then reset your progress by running the command /clearkweebdrasilprogress.
